Opening Night, Twice

SSF-HS10-L1-BR300-HSVPA910-TTM-AAD · HS Theatre 9–10 · Evaluating a Theatre Work
THE DIRECTIONS
You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.
The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.
THE LOCK
The Four Tests
As you record, the four facts fill in. Match each fact to one test: art form, history, culture, or another subject.
STOP 1
ONE ROOM
The whole play is in one apartment.
STOP 2
$10,000
One family must share it.
STOP 3
A DANCE FROM NIGERIA
The daughter dances to music from Nigeria.
STOP 4
THE WRITER'S OWN HOUSE
Her real family fought for their home.
INSIDE THE PLAYOUTSIDE THE PLAY
THE SCENE
You are a time traveler in New York in 1959. Tonight is the first night of a new play. Your team in 2026 needs four facts to judge it. Four people can help you before you travel home.
THE HISTORY
This mission is about the play A Raisin in the Sun. Lorraine Hansberry wrote it when she was 28. It is the first play by a Black woman on Broadway. It is about a Black family in Chicago with big dreams.
